properties.NAME: Termadus

properties.NAME: Acilaris
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: barely large enough to be considered a planetoid; had enough gravity to hold an atmosphere laden with sulfur, carbon, and boron; surface too hot even for a ship to land; was believed to be rich in natural minerals, crystals; temperature prohibited mining activities; in 31 BBY, rumors of the droids of Uffel accepting contracts to design mining machinery able to withstand the local conditions
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Cularin
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: first charted during New Sith Wars, as Jedi expelled Darth Rivan from system; forgotten after 1250 BBY until rediscovery by Reidi Artom in 232 BBY; Tarasin revolted against TF from 161 - 154 BBY (resolved by the Jedi with Cularin Compact), but TF eventually exploited loopholes, gained control of the system, opposed only by Riboga's systemwide criminal Organization; known for exotic hardwoods, especially the ch'hala; whole planet was considered strong in the Force
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Rennokk
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.KNOWN_ENVIRONMENTS: magma seas, rocky mountain islands, volcanoes
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: molten planetoid; glow was visible on Cularin; Reidi Artom's survey indicated minerals of interest in planetoid's lava but nobody had attempted to reach them by 31 BBY; rocky outcroppings rising out of the magma; Reidi Artom landed on the tallest one and dubbed it Artom's Crest; rumored metallic city in a cave; Artom revisited and fled after being chased by some sort of large life-form
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Tilnes
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.KNOWN_ENVIRONMENTS: barren rock, caverns, subsurface crystal mines
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: had atmosphere; barely capable of sustaining life; orbit sometimes took it too close to Morasil; only native life forms were hardy grass, yri worms; meteorite uncovered crystal deposits; crystals could be used for blasters, lightsabers; mining settlements moved underground; crystals, radiation, seismic activity combined to create pulses that interfered with the operation of droids
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Genarius
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: floating cities viewed as relatively lawless by system's standards; mixture of gases rare in the galaxy (many existed in stable form due to radiation from planet's core, which gave off its own glow, heat and energy due to low-energy fusion); forceful windstorms, deadly radiation swept up from below, devastating unprotected cities; cochlera: native jellyfish-like creature
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Ulbasca
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: occupied primary orbit around planet; orbited such that it was always in light of Cularin system's two suns; reflected from Genarius meant that even the side of Ulbasca facing away from sunlight never experienced true night; type II atmosphere requiring breath mask for visits of more than a few hours; only major life forms were lizards and snakes; largest could grow up to 40 meters
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Uffel
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: droid manufacturing moon run, inhabited, owned entirely by droids; thick poisonous atmosphere; perpetually in twilight during its day; first droids came to Uffel with a pair of Twi'leks who were killed when ship crashed while surveying moon in 90 BBY; QS-2D (modified protocol droid) and two R4 units survived; QS-2D determined they were free, decided to mine the moon
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Ostfrei
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: very dark; unique orbit kept it in the shadow of Genarius most of the time; thick atmosphere prevented most light from reaching surface; habitable at one time, but asteroid impacts from Oblis' destruction started seismic chain-reaction leaving the moon uninhabitable; ignored by most of the residents of system; Thaereian Navy had secret military base on Ostfrei since c. 31 BBY
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Eskaron
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: originally inhabitable; perforated by tunnels made by space worms, exposing molten core, destroying local atmosphere and killing several worms; worms moved on after metal was depleted; most tunnels large enough for starships to fly through (some were kilometers wide); organized races set up by Riboga since 72 BBY; continued after Nirama took over in 53 BBY, still active in 32 BBY
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Cularin Belt (Oblis)
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.NOTES: formerly planet
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: Oblis originally a technologically-advanced jungle planet with large crystal deposits; destroyed by weapon powered by the Darkstaff before 1000 BBY; remnants became Cularin Belt; used as a hiding place by Nirama's smugglers; Nirama's criminal organization was based on largest asteroid (400 km diameter); rest of belt was pirate hideout; ships had to exit hyperspace to go further in-system
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Crystal Snare
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: one of the stranger asteroids in the belt; remnant of the large crystal deposits in Oblis, the planet whose destruction formed the Cularin Belt
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Almas
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.KNOWN_ENVIRONMENTS: desolate wastelands, grasslands, 2 small mountain ranges
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: received little sunlight; despite hot core, not very geologically active; atmosphere initially filled with poisonous gases until Darth Rivan developed kaluthin grass (leaves had glowing phosphorus deposits, lending the world a glowing aura) to alter the atmosphere and produce oxygen; no surface water, but grass drew upon underground lakes, to which settlers would later build wells
properties.PLACEMENT_LOGIC: Essential Atlas, TFA RPG Beginner Game/

properties.NAME: Dorumaa
properties.PARENT: Expansion Region/unknown/4527/Thaere/Cularin
properties.INTERESTING (move to 2nd to last positio: originally an inner planet, with orbit crossing Oblis'; Dorumaa was at its closest when Oblis was destroyed, flinging it outward to be captured by Almas, and froze; Dorumaa Investment Group began terraforming in 47 BBY, installing gravity and power generators near the moon's core to warm it and recycle atmosphere; became a top resort world, tourist destination in the Expansion Region
